inputs.ad_text_01: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Medium shot in a bank meeting room. An East Asian developer brings an old loan folder to a female bank credit officer. She sets a new loan proposal next to the old contract and points at its repayment schedule. The developer compares the two pages with a calculator and looks concerned. Show old contract versus new proposal clearly as two folders.
